title: 孔內電視與裂隙判釋~Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation
focus: 以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙~Interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks
summary: 本課聚焦以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 光學與聲學互補~Optical and acoustic complementarity
units.title: 光學與聲學互補~Optical and acoustic complementarity
units.mechanism: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。互補資料可區分影像消失與真正的構造中斷，不能把看不清的區段當成無裂隙。 假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。~Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. Turbid water and coatings affect them differently, so combined evidence separates lost visibility from a real structural termination. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method.
units.verify: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。~Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.
units.failure: 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。~Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.
units.misconception: 孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。~Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄光學與聲學互補的資料來源與適用條件。逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for optical and acoustic complementarity. Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.

units.anchor: 展開影像與傾角~Unwrapped images and dip
units.title: 展開影像與傾角~Unwrapped images and dip
units.mechanism: 平面裂隙切穿圓孔時在展開圖上形成正弦曲線；波幅與孔徑共同決定相對孔軸的傾角。只有孔軸近鉛直且坐標已校正時，簡單幾何傾角才可直接視為地質傾角。 假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。 把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。~A planar fracture intersecting a circular hole becomes a sinusoid when unwrapped. Its amplitude and hole diameter determine dip relative to the axis. This simple dip represents geological dip directly only for a properly oriented near-vertical hole. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°.
units.verify: 以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。~Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry.
units.failure: 把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。~Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry.
units.misconception: 展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。~The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄展開影像與傾角的資料來源與適用條件。以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for unwrapped images and dip. Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination.

units.anchor: 深度與速度校準~Depth and speed calibration
units.title: 深度與速度校準~Depth and speed calibration
units.mechanism: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。垂直像素間距依賴移動速度及掃描頻率，只有固定時間間隔並不保證固定深度間距，必須使用校正後的深度編碼。 假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。~Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log. Vertical pixel spacing depends on travel speed and scan frequency; fixed time intervals do not guarantee fixed depth spacing without corrected depth encoding. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm. Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm.
units.verify: 利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。~Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane.
units.failure: 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。~Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane.
units.misconception: 掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。~A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄深度與速度校準的資料來源與適用條件。利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for depth and speed calibration. Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement.

units.anchor: 磁方位與鋼材影響~Magnetic azimuth and steel effects
units.title: 磁方位與鋼材影響~Magnetic azimuth and steel effects
units.mechanism: 磁羅盤在鋼套管附近或含磁性礦物岩層會失真，圖像正北標記因此不一定是地理北。方位偏差不改變正弦形狀，故肉眼難以發現，必須以獨立定向資料檢查。 假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。 把磁北當真北會讓所有節理組一致旋轉，統計仍集中卻整體錯誤；若再與隧道軸線比較，可能錯判某組是否會朝開挖空間出露。~Steel casing and magnetic minerals disturb a compass, so the image north marker may differ from geographic north. Azimuth bias leaves sinusoidal shape unchanged and is hard to spot visually, requiring independent orientation evidence. For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct. Treating magnetic north as true north rotates every joint set coherently, preserving a tight but wrong distribution. Comparison with the tunnel axis can then misidentify whether a set daylights into the opening.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct.
units.verify: 將磁場強度及套管位置隨深度繪圖，對照陀螺定向或已知方向控制段；標明磁偏角轉換年份與坐標基準，超出可接受方位不確定度的區段不得直接用於楔體分析。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把磁北當真北會讓所有節理組一致旋轉，統計仍集中卻整體錯誤；若再與隧道軸線比較，可能錯判某組是否會朝開挖空間出露。~Plot magnetic strength and casing position with depth and compare gyro orientation or a known control interval; document declination date and coordinate datum, excluding inadequately oriented intervals from direct wedge analysis. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating magnetic north as true north rotates every joint set coherently, preserving a tight but wrong distribution. Comparison with the tunnel axis can then misidentify whether a set daylights into the opening.
units.failure: 把磁北當真北會讓所有節理組一致旋轉，統計仍集中卻整體錯誤；若再與隧道軸線比較，可能錯判某組是否會朝開挖空間出露。~Treating magnetic north as true north rotates every joint set coherently, preserving a tight but wrong distribution. Comparison with the tunnel axis can then misidentify whether a set daylights into the opening.
units.misconception: 影像正北標記必定等於地理北，鋼套管不會影響。~Image north always equals geographic north and is unaffected by steel casing.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄磁方位與鋼材影響的資料來源與適用條件。將磁場強度及套管位置隨深度繪圖，對照陀螺定向或已知方向控制段；標明磁偏角轉換年份與坐標基準，超出可接受方位不確定度的區段不得直接用於楔體分析。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for magnetic azimuth and steel effects. Plot magnetic strength and casing position with depth and compare gyro orientation or a known control interval; document declination date and coordinate datum, excluding inadequately oriented intervals from direct wedge analysis.

units.anchor: 孔徑與工具偏心~Caliper and tool eccentricity
units.title: 孔徑與工具偏心~Caliper and tool eccentricity
units.mechanism: 工具偏離孔中心會讓不同方位的聲程不對稱，孔徑擴大又改變影像的幾何比例。橢圓孔壁可能是原位應力破壞，也可能來自鑽進磨損，不能只憑一張孔徑圖指定成因。 假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。 偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。~Tool eccentricity makes acoustic paths unequal around the hole, while enlargement changes image scale. An elliptical wall may reflect stress-induced damage or drilling wear; one caliper image cannot establish the cause. Assumed orthogonal diameters 110 and 100 mm give ovality (110−100)/100=10%; this is a geometric index, not a stress ratio. Eccentricity bands may be mistaken for paired breakouts, while excessive correction can erase genuine damage. Either error seriously misdirects stress orientation and subsequent support interpretations.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed orthogonal diameters 110 and 100 mm give ovality (110−100)/100=10%; this is a geometric index, not a stress ratio.
units.verify: 比較多臂孔徑、工具居中狀態及兩次影像，檢查異常是否固定在地理方向；若形狀跟工具旋轉而變，優先查量測偏心，只有重複且有岩壁證據的特徵才供應力判釋。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。~Compare multi-arm caliper, centralization and repeat images, checking whether anomalies remain fixed geographically; if shape follows tool rotation investigate eccentricity first, reserving stress interpretation for repeatable wall-supported features. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Eccentricity bands may be mistaken for paired breakouts, while excessive correction can erase genuine damage. Either error seriously misdirects stress orientation and subsequent support interpretations.
units.failure: 偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。~Eccentricity bands may be mistaken for paired breakouts, while excessive correction can erase genuine damage. Either error seriously misdirects stress orientation and subsequent support interpretations.
units.misconception: 孔壁橢圓化一定由原位應力造成，不可能是鑽進效應。~Borehole ovality always comes from in-situ stress rather than drilling effects.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄孔徑與工具偏心的資料來源與適用條件。比較多臂孔徑、工具居中狀態及兩次影像，檢查異常是否固定在地理方向；若形狀跟工具旋轉而變，優先查量測偏心，只有重複且有岩壁證據的特徵才供應力判釋。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for caliper and tool eccentricity. Compare multi-arm caliper, centralization and repeat images, checking whether anomalies remain fixed geographically; if shape follows tool rotation investigate eccentricity first, reserving stress interpretation for repeatable wall-supported features.

units.anchor: 表觀裂隙開度~Apparent fracture aperture
units.title: 表觀裂隙開度~Apparent fracture aperture
units.mechanism: 影像中的暗帶寬度同時受真實開度、斜交幾何、像素尺寸與覆膜影響。聲學反射缺失也可能因粗糙度造成，所以影像開度是觀測描述，不能未校準就代入裂隙流公式。 假設像素尺度0.2 mm、暗帶3像素，表觀寬0.6 mm；若邊界各有1像素誤差，寬度誤差可達0.4 mm。 將暗帶寬直接當水力開度會因立方關係放大流量誤差，岩壁染色更可能使封閉裂隙看似很寬；錯誤導水判斷會誤導後續調查位置。~A dark band width reflects true aperture, intersection angle, pixel size and coatings. Missing acoustic returns may also result from roughness. Image aperture is therefore an observation, not an uncalibrated input to fracture-flow equations. At an assumed pixel scale 0.2 mm, a 3-pixel band is 0.6 mm wide; one-pixel error at each boundary can change width by 0.4 mm. Using band width as hydraulic aperture amplifies flow errors through the cubic relation, and staining can make a closed crack look wide, misdirecting subsequent investigation of conductive zones.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設像素尺度0.2 mm、暗帶3像素，表觀寬0.6 mm；若邊界各有1像素誤差，寬度誤差可達0.4 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed pixel scale 0.2 mm, a 3-pixel band is 0.6 mm wide; one-pixel error at each boundary can change width by 0.4 mm.
units.verify: 用已知縫寬標準件評估影像點擴散與邊界選取，再比較不同光源或聲學模式；把表觀寬度、校準開度與液壓等效開度分欄保存，無法換算者不得混用。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將暗帶寬直接當水力開度會因立方關係放大流量誤差，岩壁染色更可能使封閉裂隙看似很寬；錯誤導水判斷會誤導後續調查位置。~Evaluate edge selection and image spreading with a known-gap target and compare illumination or acoustic modes; preserve apparent width, calibrated aperture and hydraulic aperture in separate fields and do not interchange unconverted values. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using band width as hydraulic aperture amplifies flow errors through the cubic relation, and staining can make a closed crack look wide, misdirecting subsequent investigation of conductive zones.
units.failure: 將暗帶寬直接當水力開度會因立方關係放大流量誤差，岩壁染色更可能使封閉裂隙看似很寬；錯誤導水判斷會誤導後續調查位置。~Using band width as hydraulic aperture amplifies flow errors through the cubic relation, and staining can make a closed crack look wide, misdirecting subsequent investigation of conductive zones.
units.misconception: 影像暗帶寬度可直接當成裂隙的水力開度。~The width of a dark image band directly equals hydraulic fracture aperture.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄表觀裂隙開度的資料來源與適用條件。用已知縫寬標準件評估影像點擴散與邊界選取，再比較不同光源或聲學模式；把表觀寬度、校準開度與液壓等效開度分欄保存，無法換算者不得混用。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for apparent fracture aperture. Evaluate edge selection and image spreading with a known-gap target and compare illumination or acoustic modes; preserve apparent width, calibrated aperture and hydraulic aperture in separate fields and do not interchange unconverted values.

units.anchor: 裂隙組與取樣偏差~Joint sets and sampling bias
units.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差~Joint sets and sampling bias
units.mechanism: 孔壁看到的是被孔截交的裂隙，不是所有方向等機率的樣本。組群分析應同時考慮取向、深度與可讀性，少量離群點可能是真實構造轉折，不能為了漂亮群集全部刪除。 假設可讀孔段20 m截交30條裂隙，線性密度1.5 m⁻¹；不經方向修正不能當體積裂隙密度。 若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。~The image includes only fractures intersected by the hole, not an equal-probability sample of orientations. Clustering must consider direction, depth and readability; a few outliers may mark real structural changes rather than disposable noise. If an assumed readable 20 m interval intersects 30 fractures, linear intensity is 1.5 m⁻¹; it is not volumetric fracture density without orientation treatment. Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge. Including unreadable intervals in the denominator also underestimates fracture intensity and creates artificial improvement in rock quality.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設可讀孔段20 m截交30條裂隙，線性密度1.5 m⁻¹；不經方向修正不能當體積裂隙密度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed readable 20 m interval intersects 30 fractures, linear intensity is 1.5 m⁻¹; it is not volumetric fracture density without orientation treatment.
units.verify: 以球面圖標示每條裂隙及其深度，和不同方向孔的組群比較；保留人工挑點、擬合殘差及可讀性遮罩，只有可解釋的測量錯誤可排除，地質離群則另列。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。~Plot each fracture with depth on a stereonet and compare differently oriented holes; retain manual picks, fit residuals and readability masks, excluding only justified measurement errors while retaining geological outliers separately. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge. Including unreadable intervals in the denominator also underestimates fracture intensity and creates artificial improvement in rock quality.
units.failure: 若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。~Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge. Including unreadable intervals in the denominator also underestimates fracture intensity and creates artificial improvement in rock quality.
units.misconception: 每一種節理方向被單一鑽孔取樣的機率都相同。~A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄裂隙組與取樣偏差的資料來源與適用條件。以球面圖標示每條裂隙及其深度，和不同方向孔的組群比較；保留人工挑點、擬合殘差及可讀性遮罩，只有可解釋的測量錯誤可排除，地質離群則另列。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint sets and sampling bias. Plot each fracture with depth on a stereonet and compare differently oriented holes; retain manual picks, fit residuals and readability masks, excluding only justified measurement errors while retaining geological outliers separately.

units.anchor: 導水裂隙交叉證據~Cross-evidence for conductive fractures
units.title: 導水裂隙交叉證據~Cross-evidence for conductive fractures
units.mechanism: 影像辨識開放構造，流量測井辨識水的實際交換，兩者回答不同問題。多條裂隙可能只有一條連通遠方含水層，水力邊界改變時導水角色也可能改變，不能只依外觀排序。 假設某裂隙上下流量由0.20增至0.35 L/s，局部增量0.15 L/s；只有深度與穩態條件一致時可歸因。 缺少深度校準會把流量躍變配到鄰近裂隙，非穩態儲存也能製造假交換；結果可能在錯誤位置安排封堵，留下真正的導水通道。~Images identify visible structures while flow logs identify actual water exchange. Among many fractures only one may connect to a distant aquifer. Hydraulic boundary changes can alter their roles, so appearance alone cannot rank conductivity. An assumed flow increase from 0.20 to 0.35 L/s across a fracture gives 0.15 L/s locally, attributable only with aligned depth and steady conditions. Depth mismatch assigns a flow change to the wrong fracture, and transient storage can mimic exchange. Treatment may then target the wrong location while the true conductive path remains unresolved.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設某裂隙上下流量由0.20增至0.35 L/s，局部增量0.15 L/s；只有深度與穩態條件一致時可歸因。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed flow increase from 0.20 to 0.35 L/s across a fracture gives 0.15 L/s locally, attributable only with aligned depth and steady conditions.
units.verify: 將孔內流量、溫度與影像裂隙標記對齊，核對抽水或自然狀態及時間；以隔離區間試驗確認連通，報告將可見裂隙與證實導水裂隙分開，避免外觀推論充當試驗結果。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：缺少深度校準會把流量躍變配到鄰近裂隙，非穩態儲存也能製造假交換；結果可能在錯誤位置安排封堵，留下真正的導水通道。~Align flow, temperature and image picks, documenting pumping or ambient state and time; confirm connectivity with interval testing and distinguish visible fractures from hydraulically demonstrated ones in the report. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Depth mismatch assigns a flow change to the wrong fracture, and transient storage can mimic exchange. Treatment may then target the wrong location while the true conductive path remains unresolved.
units.failure: 缺少深度校準會把流量躍變配到鄰近裂隙，非穩態儲存也能製造假交換；結果可能在錯誤位置安排封堵，留下真正的導水通道。~Depth mismatch assigns a flow change to the wrong fracture, and transient storage can mimic exchange. Treatment may then target the wrong location while the true conductive path remains unresolved.
units.misconception: 看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。~The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄導水裂隙交叉證據的資料來源與適用條件。將孔內流量、溫度與影像裂隙標記對齊，核對抽水或自然狀態及時間；以隔離區間試驗確認連通，報告將可見裂隙與證實導水裂隙分開，避免外觀推論充當試驗結果。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cross-evidence for conductive fractures. Align flow, temperature and image picks, documenting pumping or ambient state and time; confirm connectivity with interval testing and distinguish visible fractures from hydraulically demonstrated ones in the report.

units.anchor: 自動判讀與盲查~Automated interpretation and blind checks
units.title: 自動判讀與盲查~Automated interpretation and blind checks
units.mechanism: 演算法擅長找連續曲線，但電纜陰影、層理和鑽痕也可形成規律圖樣。訓練資料的岩性與水況限制模型外推，須以獨立人工盲查估計漏判和誤判，而非只看輸出數量。 假設人工確認20條裂隙，模型找到16條且另誤報4條，召回率16/20=80%，精確率16/(16+4)=80%。 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。~Algorithms find continuous curves, but cable shadows, bedding and drill marks can also form regular patterns. Training lithology and water conditions limit transfer, requiring independent blind checks of misses and false detections rather than output counts alone. For an assumed 20 confirmed fractures, 16 detections plus 4 false positives give recall 80% and precision 16/(16+4)=80%. Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設人工確認20條裂隙，模型找到16條且另誤報4條，召回率16/20=80%，精確率16/(16+4)=80%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 20 confirmed fractures, 16 detections plus 4 false positives give recall 80% and precision 16/(16+4)=80%.
units.verify: 預先選定含不同可讀性與岩性的盲查區段，將人工與模型逐條配對並保存漏判原因；部署版本與訓練域需可追溯，不以同一批調參影像宣稱獨立驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。~Preselect blind intervals covering lithology and readability, match manual and model detections and retain reasons for misses; preserve deployed version and training domain, never calling tuning images independent validation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias.
units.failure: 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。~Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias.
units.misconception: 使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。~Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄自動判讀與盲查的資料來源與適用條件。預先選定含不同可讀性與岩性的盲查區段，將人工與模型逐條配對並保存漏判原因；部署版本與訓練域需可追溯，不以同一批調參影像宣稱獨立驗證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for automated interpretation and blind checks. Preselect blind intervals covering lithology and readability, match manual and model detections and retain reasons for misses; preserve deployed version and training domain, never calling tuning images independent validation.

units.anchor: 影像資料工程交接~Image-data engineering handover
units.title: 影像資料工程交接~Image-data engineering handover
units.mechanism: 成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。深度、方位、孔徑與採集條件必須形成版本一致的資料組，否則漂亮三維模型不能支援可追溯的工程審查。 假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。~Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. Depth, azimuth, diameter and acquisition conditions must form a version-consistent dataset; an attractive three-dimensional model alone cannot support an auditable engineering review. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps. Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps.
units.verify: 隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。~Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed.
units.failure: 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。~Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed.
units.misconception: 只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。~Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄影像資料工程交接的資料來源與適用條件。隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for image-data engineering handover. Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method.
教學量化備忘：假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°.

教學量化備忘：假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。~Teaching quantitative note: At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm.

教學量化備忘：假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct.

教學量化備忘：假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed orthogonal diameters 110 and 100 mm give ovality (110−100)/100=10%; this is a geometric index, not a stress ratio.

教學量化備忘：假設像素尺度0.2 mm、暗帶3像素，表觀寬0.6 mm；若邊界各有1像素誤差，寬度誤差可達0.4 mm。~Teaching quantitative note: At an assumed pixel scale 0.2 mm, a 3-pixel band is 0.6 mm wide; one-pixel error at each boundary can change width by 0.4 mm.
